shortDescription: Manage replication pairs on Dell PowerFlex

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: pair_id
options.description: The ID of the replication pair. Mutually exclusive with I(pair_name).

options.name: pair_name
options.description: The name of the replication pair. Mutually exclusive with I(pair_id).

options.name: pairs
options.description: List of replication pairs to add to rcg.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: pause
options.description: Pause or resume the initial copy of replication pair.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: rcg_id
options.description: The ID of the replication consistency group. Mutually exclusive with I(rcg_name).

options.name: rcg_name
options.description: The name of the replication consistency group. Mutually exclusive with I(rcg_id).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
